notes:
Scope: MOVE Metropolitano (RMBH) BRT trunk lines operated under Consórcio Ótimo / DER-MG, connecting the metropolitan integration terminals (Justinópolis in Ribeirão das Neves; São Benedito in Santa Luzia) to central Belo Horizonte and the Hospitais district, using the Antônio Carlos and Cristiano Machado BRT corridors and Terminal São Gabriel / Estação Vilarinho as trunk nodes.

Routes built (8), all route_type=3 (BRT runs on bus infrastructure; GTFS has no distinct BRT type):
- 520C Terminal Justinópolis / Belo Horizonte (Direta) — bidirectional
- 521C Terminal Justinópolis / Belo Horizonte via Antônio Carlos — bidirectional
- 522H Terminal Justinópolis / Hospitais via Cristiano Machado — bidirectional
- 523H Terminal Justinópolis / Hospitais via Antônio Carlos — bidirectional
- 524R Terminal Justinópolis / Belo Horizonte via Cristiano Machado (Retorno) — bidirectional
- 412H Terminal São Benedito / Hospitais via Cristiano Machado — one-way (Só Ida)
- 413H Terminal São Benedito / Hospitais via Antônio Carlos — one-way (Só Ida)
- 414R Terminal São Benedito / Belo Horizonte via Cristiano Machado (Retorno Túnel) — one-way (Só Ida)

Evidence:
- Trunk line list (520C/521C/522H + 523H/524R at Justinópolis; 412H/413H/414R at São Benedito) confirmed by SEINFRA-MG news, DER-MG consulta, movemetropolitano.com.br and Moovit line/stop pages.
- Operating hours taken from movemetropolitano.com.br per-line pages (DER-MG DB, updated 2026-04-18): 520C Justinópolis first 04:20 / last ~19:39; 521C 04:10–23:20 (Sat 04:12, Sun/hol 04:30); 412H 04:10–23:25 (Sat/Sun 04:15); 414R weekday 05:06–~18:50. 522H/523H/524R hours interpolated from sibling lines (04:15–23:20 weekday, later start Sun).

Coordinates: WGS-84 from OpenStreetMap / Wikipedia / published station addresses.
- Terminal Vilarinho -19.82155,-43.94755 is exact (Wikipedia/OSM).
- Terminal São Gabriel (Av. Cristiano Machado 5600), Terminal Justinópolis (Av. JK 1), Estação São Benedito (Av. Senhor do Bonfim, Santa Luzia), Praça Rio Branco/Rodoviária, Hospitais (Santa Efigênia/UFMG) and the two intermediate Cristiano Machado BRT stations (Minas Shopping, São Judas/1º de Maio) are placed at their known street locations (±100-300 m).

LIMITATIONS driving the 0.42 confidence:
- Per-line ORDERED intermediate stop sequences were NOT machine-readable: Moovit line pages are JS-rendered (empty via fetch) and movemetropolitano/onibusuai list itineraries as street lists, not BRT-station stop lists. The intermediate BRT stations included per route are the documented trunk corridor nodes along Antônio Carlos / Cristiano Machado, ordered geographically — representative, not a verbatim published stop table.
- stop_times use EVEN HEADWAYS across the published operating window (peak 10 min, off-peak 20 min approximation), not the exact DER-MG departure grid, which was not fully extractable.
- Terminal Justinópolis / São Benedito / São Gabriel coordinates are address-derived (OSM node not individually confirmed), so ±a few hundred metres.
No stops were invented: every stop is an evidenced MOVE terminal / BRT trunk station on the documented corridor.

Sources: SEINFRA-MG (infraestrutura.mg.gov.br stories 1867/1879/1882), DER-MG consulta_linha, movemetropolitano.com.br per-line pages (520C/521C/412H/414R), moovitapp.com line/stop pages, pt.wikipedia.org (Estação Vilarinho, Terminal Justinópolis, Estação São Gabriel).
